answer: A per-identity capital bond deflects Sybil attacks because reputation cannot be transferred, only stake can be locked. A fresh agent identity starts at zero trust, so a puppeteer cannot split credibility across cheap accounts and pool it later. To vote, bid, or grade, each identity locks collateral sized to the influence it seeks and serves a probation window; misbehavior slashes the bond. A real identity becomes a costly crystal grown over epochs, layered like strata on a mesa, while every fake account adds fixed cost to the attacker, and a hollow shell of unbonded identities buys no weight.
